title: Whimp
wikitext:
Oldschool QuakeWorld player from Denmark very active especially from [[1996]]-[[2001]]. He was able to take advantage of the vast benefit of working in an Internet Café during the birth of QuakeWorld and consequently managed to play with best Danish QuakeWorld players around at the time. Whimp retired from active gaming at some point in the new millenium and decided to make a subtle comeback in [[2008]].
